description: Register a dagster-dbt DbtCloudClientResource for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

auth_token_env_var.label: Auth Token Env Var
auth_token_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the dbt Cloud API token

disable_schedule_on_trigger.label: Disable Schedule On Trigger
disable_schedule_on_trigger.description: Whether triggering a job run through this resource also disables that job's own cron schedule in dbt Cloud. The underlying dagster-dbt DbtCloudResource defaults this to True; this component defaults it to False instead, matching Airflow's dbt Cloud operators, which never disable a job's schedule as a side effect of triggering it.

name: dbt Cloud Resource
